name: What is the process for starting a foreclosed property repair project?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for starting a foreclosed property repair project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with a comprehensive property inspection to identify all necessary repairs. Next, obtain detailed estimates from qualified contractors. After selecting a contractor, finalize the scope of work and contracts. The contractor will then assist with necessary permits before commencing work. Regular communication and project oversight are key throughout the renovation process until completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start with inspection, get contractor estimates, finalize contracts, secure permits, and then begin renovation with ongoing oversight.
